text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mirako~! It's thy birthday, isn't it~? 
Goodness me, I spent all the way up until 
today agonizing over what gift to give!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, nothing strengthens our bond like 
a feast! Anything is fine~, just name 
whatever you like~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Even though you already joined me for 
dinner yesterday?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, look, it's my treat today! 
That makes it completely different, so go 
on, spit it out!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What're you starin' at my face for? There 
ain't nothin' on it. Nothin' at all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...No Reason-chan. You can't fool my 
eyes, you know~?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, nailed it~! It's fine though, that 
totally happens when you're busy.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"...Hmm? Come to think of it, Mirako, 
during that classmate's birthday 
celebration the other day—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-whoa-whoa! Let's go eat, eat! I 
wonder what you're gonna treat me to~! 
Whee, whee♪
